predictions: For the fourth time this season, we reeled in an 18-7 week (which isn't that surprising since that's the weekly record that very nearly matches my season average). That brings my season total to 195-79 (71.2% correct), which would be a lot better if I hadn't dumped an 0-3 record in C last week (and has separated C off as my clearly worst division for the season at just 59.4% correct). At least I'm within one of even (or better, or much much better) with every team but For Kids now.

Match of the week: (C Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ Shooter McGavin. After last week's round of super gifts, McGavin is right back in the driver's seat in C. And who really needs to take McGavin out the most? Their opponents tonight, of course. Hump Day (the C point leader) is pulling for Off Constantly too. And the story of this race returns to really awesome if OC wins. So, Constantly it is, 13-11.

Match #2: (G Div.) Bottoms Up @ Killer Dee's. The Dee's took down She Said last week, and now they have a chance to pretty much just eliminate another contender tonight. Is there time left for the Dee's to actually get ahead of both She Said and Vader's since their point race is a lost cause? Maybe. But that try continues with this win. KD, 14-10.

Matches #3 & #4: (D Div.) Village Idiots @ Red-eye Rangers; Reload @ DD-214. Reload's point lead gives them control of the D race over the Idiots, but if either of the leaders blink for just one night, that could be the one mistake that costs the crown. And tonight those two 2-loss leaders each face one of the two 4-loss chase duo, so this is the single most dangerous night still on the schedule. The Idiots lost this pairing last time around, but I think they've got it going now, and win, 13-11. Meanwhile, DD is super hot… but Reload is on a bit of a mission, 14-10.

Matches #5 & #6: (A Div.) Element XL @ Lunatic Fringe; 2 Liver Die with LA @ The Bullies. Ok, A division has reached a recently common position where the top two are set to try to get past the #3 and #4 teams on the way to a week 14 showdown. At the same time, Fringe is still close enough that a big run of their own could move them up to a top-2 spot, so they are doubly dangerous in this context. I think both leaders get by, though one will be a bit closer. Element, 15-9; and Bullies, 18-6.

Matches #7 & #8: (C Div.) Rif Raf @ The Outlaws; Menace 2 Sobriety @ Darty Sanchez. One or two of the bottom teams in C is likely to find themselves in D next season. The Outlaws and Rif Raf each already have 4 wins, so the winner of their match tonight is basically safe. Meanwhile, the winner of the other match is likely to race the first match's loser over the last two weeks. Interestingly, the two teams in the cellar matchup are both on two-win streaks! Outlaws, fresh off a big win, win again, 14-10. And it's Sanchez, 15-9.

Match #9: (D Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Ton 80 Proof. This might be a head-to-head battle to determine who finishes in a bottom-two spot (and possibly drops to E). Machine barely won this pairing the last time around, and this time they win by a little bit more, 14-10.

Match #10: (E Div.) Duck Around & Find Out @ Liquor Possee. Possee got the huge win last week and could be cruising to the E title now. But tonight's 7th place opponent has won 3 of their last 5 and is not to be overlooked. Possee doesn't Duck Around, 15-9.

Match #11: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ Rippin Darts. Rippin is nearly locked into their finish now. Too far behind to catch 1st. And too far ahead of 3rd to be caught… no? Maybe if they can ring up a big enough upset tonight, Sofa can reel Rippin in? Nah. Rippin, 13-11.

Match #12: (E Div.) Cheap Shots @ Dart Side of the Moon. Dart Side was three-quarters of the way to taking the E lead last week. And now they have to push back a team on a 4-match win streak(!) to avoid the possibility of losing their top-two spot. Dart Side, 14-10.
